title: Accepted Craftsman headless contract v1
description: Accepted October 20, 2026, not a shipped CLI. Structural schemas require the semantic and transport checks in check_exec.py. Unknown fields/events remain additive; exact known outcomes use standard ACP stop reasons/statuses. Trace v1 is a separate unchanged measurement contract.

token_admission.description: Proposed October 31, 2026 clarification for #97; not runtime admission or billing. Describes a rejected request reservation before observed usage exhausts the token budget. Counters are integer literals; semantic relations are checked independently.
